description: Immerse yourself in powerful sound with pTron Studio Pro Over-Ear Wireless Headphones, designed for music lovers and gamers alike. Equipped with advanced Bluetooth v5.4 for fast, stable connectivity, these Bluetooth headphones feature 40mm dynamic drivers that deliver deep bass and clear highs for an exceptional audio experience. Enjoy up to 65 hours of uninterrupted playtime on a single charge, with quick recharging via Type-C in just 2.5 hours. The built-in HD Mic with AI-ENC ensures crystal-clear voice calls by reducing background noise, making conversations seamless. With dual device pairing, you can easily switch between your phone and laptop without missing a beat. Whether you’re gaming or listening to music, the dedicated Game & Music Mode offers low-latency sync for smooth performance. Designed for all-day comfort, Studio Pro comes with an adjustable headbeam and foldable design for easy portability. Plus, the 3.5mm Aux port keeps you connected even without battery power. 6-month manufacturer warranty from the date of purchase on manufacturing defects only.
